notes.title: Introducing Hive Jump Survivors
notes.content:
[h1]Attention Jumpers![/h1]

After all these years, the lines of communication from the H.S.A. have come alive once again. Tales of lone survivors from missions past have reached us. Brave soldiers have retreated to the planets' surfaces after failed attempts to eradicate from within. These Jumpers must withstand the renewed onslaught that awaits them. They must do what they can... to survive. Read on! 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2545740/Hive_Jump_Survivors/]Wishlist Hive Jump Survivors on Steam Today! [/url]

Like the original, players will control a Jumper as they seek to blast away aliens using a variety of upgradable weapons, utilities, and grenades. However, things are a bit different this time as you control a lone survivor from a troubled mission. After failing to nuke the hive from within, you have been forced to retreat to the planets' surface. Now, you stand alone against the onslaught that awaits you. No new recruits will aid you. The good news is that you can still access upgrades such as powerful flame throwers, devastating grenades, and critical utilities such as the healing totem. Will they be enough to survive? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25216346/7f95234624e0bb6ceda271ff1cc58f831b394bce.gif[/img]

[h2]The Gameplay[/h2]

Hive Jump Survivors was derived from the fun ambush moments found in the original. Players will start alone on a procedurally generated planet's surface with basic firepower. Hordes of aliens will begin to swarm the player who must fend them off one by one. As goo drops, it can be reinvested in weapon upgrades both old and new. Players must hold out as long as they can before the "boss" of that planet reveals itself as the final challenge. 

So, once again players can enjoy trying various upgrade strategies that will help them survive within the alien hives. This time, permanent upgrades can be applied by collecting a new resource called Amber. This makes each new "run" different and more exciting than the last. 

We could write forever about what's new and what's returning, but watching the sneak peek trailer below will do a much better job of getting you excited for another jump! 

[previewyoutube=JDocHEzG1Q8;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]A Fresh Look[/h2]

Hive Jump Survivors is receiving a complete visual overhaul from the original. The theme and lore will carry over, yet the new look and point of view will support the "holdout" style gameplay, allowing more game space for the action. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25216346/a32e5a1e9d3c3cdff2cf12a29046509be1f8acf8.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25216346/f4f65a1f2730e3ab30f5ca14a79444eb8b4f5a7e.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25216346/93421442a35b891643db47cc438f1ceb054f17bd.png[/img]

[h3] The Team[/h3]

We're developing Hive Jump Survivors in partnership with a local development team called Joystick. This trio of developers has close ties with Graphite Lab, and lead efforts on our 2022 release called [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1827740/Kombinera/]Kombinera[/url]. 

We're also enlisting the help of Sonamu Games, a new development initiative that you will hear more about in the coming months. 

Several core members of the original game are connected with the game as well. Matt Raithel (EP and concept artist on Hive Jump), David Greenfield (Lead QA on Hive Jump) are leading efforts from Graphite Lab's side. 

[h3]A Plan for Release[/h3]

Early Access was critical to our success with Hive Jump. So, once again, we're working to involve the players in the development of Hive Jump Survivors. We hope to bring the game to Early Access this fall where we will fine tune the experience with the support of players just like you. While development process can be a bit fluid, we expect to be in Early Access about 6 months. During this time we plan to add more content, more maps, more enemies and more action! We expect the Early Access version to be fully playable and worthy of playtime. 

We'll announce more as we work through development. The biggest help you can offer us at this time is to help spread the word and share your excitement for this next phase of the franchise. 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2545740/Hive_Jump_Survivors/]Wishlist Hive Jump Survivors on Steam Today! [/url]

As we announce this new venture, you may wonder if the original will receive updates at this point. Sadly the core development team for the original has disbanded making it unlikely that we'll revisit the original Hive Jump. Releasing Hive Jump was a major moment in our history and we've learned a lot from it. We're pressing hard to make smart decisions as we move forward with the development of Hive Jump Survivors.

notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25216346/c44cb71d94f81aea1d79aaf6bbd38399423c38e5.png[/img]

It’s been a long time since our last transmission. We’re still here. We appreciate your loyalty to the H.S.A. and our effort to reclaim the planet from the alien scum. Read on to hear news from the front lines! 

[h1]HIVE JUMP 80% OFF DURING THE STEAM WINTER SALE![/h1]
There has never been a better time to JUMP! Get Hive Jump for less than $5 during the sale. 
[b]
HEY: Why not tell your friends about the game too!?[/b] After all its lonely to jump alone. Fire up a facebook or twitter post and tell your buddies to join you in the hive!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25216346/7f1bba11a59a08a4d02170f12d6a75db248d7d53.png[/img]

[h1]Switch and XBOX Fans: Prepare to Jump! [/h1]
After several months of development and preparation, the team at Graphite Lab is excited to share that we’ve been approved for release on Nintendo Switch and XBOX One!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25216346/9faa017bc7dc3492474079a0e90366a5c3c587a4.jpg[/img]

Help us spread the word - share, post, tweet, snap, etc and let your friends know that Hive Jump is coming to Switch and XBOX One Jan 11, 2019!

Read more about this release over on our [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/graphitelab/hive-jump-0/posts/2371317]Kickstarter page[/url].

[h1]What’s Next? FAQ[/h1]

[b]Q: What about bug fixing on PC and Wii U?[/b]

[b]We’ve got some clean up to do on PC.[/b] In our efforts to bring Hive Jump to new platforms, we’ve done a little clean up, overall, to the game. We’ve invested time toward improving game elements such as the collision system and some basic bug fixing. There were some questions about certain achievements which we’ve worked to clear up and some other “behind the scenes” optimizations to tackle. We’ve learned of a few new bugs about controller detection which we’ve got in the bug queue. 

[b]About Re-bindable Controls, on all platforms…[/b] I know it’s not natural to have the jump button on a shoulder button. Decades of other titles demand that we jump with a face button. I get it. But, if you put it anywhere else you can’t jump, aim and shoot well. We’ve tried. Its not a feature that is completely off the table, but we’ve not found a config that works better so we chose to prioritize other tasks. If you want to try out different configurations on PC in the meantime, tools like JoytoKey do offer that type of support. 

A few of you were asking about controller maps in the Steam forums so we’ve whipped up a few quick guides which are over at [url=http://hivejump.com/f-a-q/]hivejump.com[/url] but are also included here: 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25216346/2c98c6e187b8e0013c3ef66748e8d50c5d67d9e8.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25216346/39cb1e7532b6669feef7c855266fa131102e3934.png[/img]


[b]Q: Will PC Multiplayer ever come out of BETA?[/b]

Online Multiplayer is not a system that is easily perfected. It works great in some cases, but in others it suffers from desyncs and performance issues. We’ve invested considerable time toward making this experience better for everyone, but issues still come up. We’ve had to be a bit pragmatic in choosing ways to move Hive Jump forward and aren’t yet in a spot where we can take that beta tag off the Online Feature. 

[b]Q: Will you be coming to PS4 next?[/b]

Nothing is announced for PS4 or any other platform at this time. 

[h1]Would you like to know more?[/h1]

As always, please leave us questions and comments below or email info@hivejump.com.

We love hearing from members of the Jump Corps! Also, if you haven't already, you should join our [url=https://discord.gg/0brjQ73VCJD2iATW]Hive Jump Discord server[/url] and say hello.

notes.title: Status Update, Conferences and FAQ!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25216346/48dd8b1bd956878338670c9dbdcd5760af14a5fe.png[/img]

[h1]Attention Jumpers![/h1]

We’ve got news from the H.S.A! The Hive Jump team at Graphite Lab has been keeping busy since the last update. Read below for some news regarding the Wii U platform, conference schedules and some frequently asked questions!

[h1]Looking to play Hive Jump on your Wii U? Keep your blasters at the ready… we’re coming soon.[/h1]

Back in March we sent out a celebratory note to our Kickstarter backers that we’d submitted to Nintendo of America for certification. Our review took a little longer than expected because of a few issues regarding our developer registration. However, thanks to the awesome work of some folks at Nintendo those issues got resolved quickly and we went into review in early April.

Check out our [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/graphitelab/hive-jump-0/posts/1875940]Kickstarter update[/url] for more news on that progress! 

[h1]FAQ[/h1]

[b]What is the state of the Steam version? Will there be updates?[/b]

The steam version is content complete. Our team is solely focused on Wii U and then physical rewards for our backers in the short term. Our testers have been continuing to review some issues with the multiplayer desyncs and have recently put in some tracking systems which will help us better identify when desyncs occur. Beyond that, we’re still researching options to improve the connectivity and reliability of the online game experience. So we're not done yet, but we don't have things like additional skins or weapons as a priority right now. 

[b]Where are my other rewards?![/b]

Are you a backer wondering about the status of your sweet backer loot? They are in the works! We’ve been delayed by the Wii U progress described above, but are nearly past those issues and should be able to resume work on these very soon. Several of our artists have been compiling art for the [b]art book[/b] and [b]jumper guide[/b], we have the [b]hoodies[/b] and [b]shirts[/b] designed and have new partners for printing selected, too! 

Thanks for being patient and for being an amazing group of fans!

[h1]Indy POP CON![/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25216346/a57d7c576fa7db78ce6493c0471b9009c75cd37d.jpg[/img]

[b]Graphite Lab will be returning to Indy Pop Con July 7 – 9, 2017![/b] Last year we were absolutely shocked to bring home the [b]Top Prize[/b] as well as [b]Best Gameplay[/b]. We’re proud to be returning so we can celebrate the teams in competition this year!

We’ll have Hive Jump on the show floor, so stop by if you are around and say hi!

As always, please leave us questions and comments below. We love hearing from members of the Jump Corps! If you’d like to get quarterly updates about what Graphite Lab is up to, [url=http://graphitelab.us2.list-manage1.com/subscribe?u=5f80d0d6e145b658c99375064&id=b6c4c33614]please sign up here![/url]

notes.title: Overshield Nerf, Ambush Fix, and other improvements!
notes.content:
[h1]Overshield Nerf, Ambush Fix, and other improvements!(1.00.3943)[/h1]

ATTENTION JUMPERS! 

We've been listening to your feedback and bug reports, and have even more improvements on the way. We agree that the Overshield is too forgiving, and have adjusted the way it functions. It now has twice the health, from 50hp -> 100hp extra, but large sources of damage like spikes or explosions will now penetrate the shield and do the remaining damage to the Jumper's health. This means that spikes will now insta-kill a Jumper with an overshield, however, get a max hp+ relic or a impale resist relic in play, and a shielded player will be at about 20hp remaining if they walk into an explosive egg with an Overshield on (as an example). Let us know how this feels!

Please keep the great feedback and bug reports coming on the Steam forums. Thanks for all your support, and we hope you're all having a blast!

[h1]Version 1.00.3943 - Full Change List[/h1]

[list]
 [*] Nerf: Overshield health doubled, but full damage amounts penetrate shield.
 [*] Fix for Lurkers not triggering proximity grenades.
 [*] Scorcher lava platforms now wait for 3 seconds before starting to submerge in the Scorcher fight.
 [*] Chat logs will now display Steam Aliases instead of Profile Names.
 [*] Fix for Hive Jump themed cursor not displaying.
 [*] Removed a stats check that may have been slowing the game down when picking up goo.
 [*] Cleaned up some DOT particle effects
 [*] Spreadshot semi-auto exploit with custom mousewheel rebinding should be fixed.
[/list]

notes.title: More Hotfixes for Launch Bugs!
notes.content:
[h1]More Hotfixes for Launch Bugs (1.00.3705)[/h1]

ATTENTION JUMPERS! It's been hectic as a hive here at good ol' Graphite Lab as we address launch day issues. Thank you for the bug reports and feedback, please keep it coming so we can crush all bugs (of the code variety!).

Here are some issues we're aware of and are working hard to fix. 

1) There are some instances where your jumper can clip through ceilings up a floor, or even into the out of bounds area around the level. We should have a fix for this tomorrow or Friday. 

2) Multiplayer stability and performance. First, we're putting the beta tag back on the Online Lobby button to signify that we know there are issues and are working to resolve them. The two areas we need to improve on are Desyncs and Automatic Performance Handling. 

At a basic level, Desyncs are caused by differences in the way players computers calculate things. We have a safety-net in place so that Desyncs don't end your runs. The Speedrun Challenge ranks players by time instead of by score, and ensures no run-killing ambush rooms. It allows you to take your unlocked equipment into the challenge with you, and provides a random hive seed each time, making it a breeding ground for world record competition. Check out Hive Jump on [url=http://www.speedrun.com/Hive_Jump]Speedrun.com[/url]

[h1]Multiplayer Stability and other improvements! (0.050.2540)[/h1]

Sorry we don't have much new content other than bug fixes. We're a small team and are working on a lot of big features at the same time. MP fixes, AI fixes, Campaign feature (big!), Story (big!), and the Wii U port. Thanks for bearing with us, and we will have much more to share with you soon!

[list]
 [*] Stability improvements for 3-4 player multiplayer on PC.

notes.title: Mac + Linux support arriving 10/12, also development updates!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25216346/48dd8b1bd956878338670c9dbdcd5760af14a5fe.png[/img]

[h1]Attention Jumpers![/h1]

We’re receiving a large data-burst from J.U.M.P. Corps Headquarters! The war effort is progressing swiftly, and there’s a lot of recent developments to cover. In this update:

[list]
    [*]Mac and Linux versions coming to Steam Early Access!
    [*]Ambush Encounters Added! 
    [*]Progress update on the Online Multiplayer feature! 
    [*]Hive Queen W.I.P. Story NPCs (Part 1) 
    [*]Darkest Dungeon’s Grave Robber in Hive Jump! 
    [*]Weekly Twitch Stream and Discord!
[/list]

There are a lot of irons in the fire currently, but we’re thrilled to be making a final push on content for the game! [b]This kind of large content push means that the next few builds might have fewer new content additions, and more minor bug fixes and improvements.[/b] With a small team, this is how it has to work to get these large content pieces like Queen / Campaign / Story done! Thanks for bearing with us!

[h1]New Mac and Linux recruits inbound! (10/12)[/h1]

We’re excited to be bringing the Early Access version of Hive Jump to our Mac and Linux backers! Initially we weren’t sure what platform-specific issues would arise and how long they would take to fix, however Unity3d has proven to have excellent cross-platform capabilities. We couldn’t be more thrilled with the porting capabilities of the engine.  

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/014/058/489/4992bd1d4e4f172dd63790b399af4675_original.png?w=639&fit=max&v=1476143625&auto=format&lossless=true&s=354ad28e03818d64b30d85e5e97a0a18[/img]
[i]Get ready to jump on 10/12/2016 on Mac and Linux![/i]

After conducting internal testing on Mac and Linux (Ubuntu) devices, we’re ready to release these versions into the wild. We’ll be counting on our backers and early access users to continue playtesting and reporting any issues they find with these specific platforms using the in-game “F1” reporter system.

[h1]They’re coming outta the walls![/h1]

Disturbing reports have reached J.U.M.P. Corps Headquarters! It appears as though the bugs are learning! They are setting ambushes within their hives, enclosing our fire-teams in small rooms and swarming them!  

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/014/058/732/e3f4d929358dfbeb5cf6689a675f9608_original.gif?w=639&fit=max&v=1476145013&q=92&s=6dc79859a9553196cf39da3926af4d25[/img]
[i]Endure and survive![/i]

Jumpers who have survived such ambushes have reported that the only path to victory is to assume a defensive position and hold out until an escape route opens up! J.U.M.P. Corps HQ recommends the use of smart turrets and healing fields to increase your odds of survival!

[h1]Squad goals: Online Multiplayer improvements![/h1]

Online Multiplayer is in the game in a beta form. Creating an initial implementation of the feature was a lot of work, and perfecting it and removing all the bugs will continue to require a lot of testing, tweaking, and programming!  

[b]As it currently stands, 2 players can play reliably, but adding a 3rd or 4th increases the chances of a desync occurring (essentially ending the run). We’re continuing to release patches with tweaks to the multiplayer system to remove these desyncs and hope to have fully stable online multiplayer soon.[/b] 

A big thank you to our Community QA group that is helping us nail down this slippery feature! If you are interested in helping too, join our Discord community and ask about CQA!

[h1]Big momma bug: Hive Queen W.I.P.[/h1]

Accurate reports of Hive Queen activity are still few and far between. However, progress on uncovering the hiding places and secrets of these queen bugs is rapid. Soon we will know more about our ultimate enemies, and we will be able to send these bugs back to the dark corners of the galaxy that they came from!  

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/014/058/594/f1564eae6d117c1e8eb1cf9a5f036e84_original.gif?w=639&fit=max&v=1476144197&q=92&s=ae603ff2532dca6ff6f8fa4c8ff38ec2[/img]
[i]Unity editor capture of the Queen's opening roar![/i]

Progress on the Queen boss fight is going well! We hope you’re ready for one epic fight! For reference, her head is the size of the Caretaker's body. Hoo-boy!

[h1]Meet the crew: Story NPCs (Part 1)[/h1]

We’re excited to begin introducing you all to the characters who will be leading the counter-offensive against the Ordovician alien menace! In Hive Jump’s Campaign mode, you will be assuming the role of a J.U.M.P. Corps commander and working with these characters to rid planets of alien infestations and make the galaxy safe for humanity again. Part one of this series teases three of our six main characters.  

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/014/058/624/dceafa8dedba97725aefeea395c840c1_original.gif?w=639&fit=max&v=1476144407&q=92&s=ae879b2b6df761d8863ec048231b1f62[/img]
[i](Left to right, Delphi, Col. Keller, Cpt. Hirose)[/i]

Col. Keller is a highly decorated member of the J.U.M.P. Corps who is currently in charge of coordinating the training of new recruits. The Ordovician War has resulted in a large human death toll, but Keller remains unfazed and insists that, “I’ve fought Xanaduvian Sabrecats with ten times the ferocity of these little buggers.” You can read her full biography in the Codex screen in the Steam Early Access build now!  

Cpt. Hirose rose quickly through the ranks of the H.S.A. Navy as an exceptional fighter pilot and squadron leader. After attending officer’s school and serving as first mate aboard other H.S.A. vessels, Hirose was made Captain of the H.S.S. Dauntless. Hirose and her crew are regularly sent to the most pivotal battlegrounds in order to turn the tide in humanity’s favor. Col. Keller and the other main characters are stationed aboard the H.S.S. Dauntless with Hirose, carrying out high-profile missions for the H.S.A.  

Delphi is a member of the H.S.A.’s PsyOps division, and humanity’s secret weapon in the Ordovician War. Created in a test-tube using a genetic engineering process that simulates generations upon generations of human evolution, Delphi possesses far stronger psychic potential than other humans in the 24th century. In order to prevent these genetic traits from being passed to the general human population, Delphi was grown without a reproductive system. Delphi’s psychic abilities will prove essential in locating and destroying Ordovician Queens, but are so dangerous that Delphi is considered a living weapon and is constantly under H.S.A. supervision. Delphi often wonders what future awaits them if humanity survives the Ordovician War…  

That’s all for now! Stay tuned for Part 2 of our story character introductions! A little taste of what’s to come… a nearly-omniscient Oracular AI, a brilliant scientist and archaeologist with a flair for the eccentric, and a loyal and valorous Runabout (robotic) construct.

[h1]Darkest Dungeon’s Grave Robber in Hive Jump![/h1]

We’re thrilled to announce that Darkest Dungeon’s Grave Robber will be making an appearance in Hive Jump! 

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/014/058/762/2815f06f1d0f3e23413b4d784159a923_original.gif?w=639&fit=max&v=1476145155&q=92&s=0ef0697d0a72a5d00180ed8302bb487f[/img]
[i]Take a knee and listen to my tale...[/i]

The Grave Robber will be a discoverable NPC within hive missions, and is actually our ONE HUNDREDTH NPC! Discover her, and many other interesting characters while jumping hives… will you find all 100?

[h1]Weekly Twitch Streams and Discord![/h1]

For a few weeks now, we’ve been doing short streams and giving away copies of Hive Jump to active community members! We’re enjoying this so much, that we want to make it a regular thing. 

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/014/058/813/5946c1367c7750da1664d392a12b00c4_original.gif?w=639&fit=max&v=1476145446&q=92&s=d195064abaf25cdae196f010d435949d[/img]

Join us every Wednesday night at 7PM CST on twitch.tv/hivejump. Get to know your other jumpers better, do Q&A with dev team members like [url=twitter.com/mattdonatelli]@mattdonatelli[/url], and maybe even win an extra game key for a friend! 

When we’re not streaming, we’re working hard on the game and keeping an eye on our Hive Jump Discord channel. Join us there using this invite! https://discord.gg/0brjQ73VCJD2iATW

[h1]Would you like to know more?[/h1]

As always, we're happy to answer any questions or comments below! 

Thanks for jumping with us!

notes.content:
[h1]Ambush Encounters and Multiplayer Lobby Improvements!(0.048.2355)[/h1]

notes.title: New Enemy Type: Lurker (v0.46.2108)
notes.content:
[h1]Introducing: The Lurker![/h1]
Jumpers! We at JUMP Corps H.Q. have disturbing news. A new species of alien has been discovered in the hives! These dangerous bugs are reminiscent of trap door spiders, and the troops have taken to calling them Lurkers. 

These aliens lay patiently in wait for their prey, well concealed in hive rock, and pounce out with piercing mandibles when their prey lingers close by. The lurker’s mandibles are capable of easily cutting through Jumper armor and will instantly sever a human or robotic spine.

Lurkers burrow into hive rock and lay in wait, making targeting and destruction of a lurker difficult. Jumpers should keep an eye out for their protruding mandibles, and use explosive weapons and grenades to deal damage to them while they remain burrowed. Avoidance is also a valid tactical option, although it’s best to give your fellow jumpers a heads up that a lurker is nearby.

[list]
    [*]Added Lurkers

    [*]Added light-casting plants to Mushroom Env.

    [*]Scorcher acid projectile now looks and behaves much better
    [*]Improved stats tracking
    [*]Daily Challenge completions/attempts now count towards player profile unlocks (skins and insignias)

[/list]

    [*] Reducing lobby bugs.

notes.title: New Boss! What to Expect from Early Access!
notes.content:
A new BOSS!

[h1]Caretaker Boss Preview[/h1]

[i]Incoming transmission from the H.S.A…[/i]

The footage you’re about to see is highly classified. A reconnaissance jump team has identified a new elite Ordovician lifeform. The troopers are calling it “The Caretaker.”

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/013/081/217/dc77d5acf04fd7f891434d48c9baf173_original.gif?w=639&fit=max&v=1468706216&q=92&s=888b9cfb9ab9d8d710059210b96c788d[/img]

This large crab-like alien moves slowly and methodically over icy terrain and harvests water in the form of ice. The caretaker's limbs cause protrusions from the far walls of the hives, giving our teams close platforms for direct assault.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/013/081/239/fbb0526c1566b385ea88ad32092e260f_original.gif?w=639&fit=max&v=1468706427&q=92&s=f2243119b16889195bb68a513b06e2e4[/img]

Its weak spot can change so Jumpers must change their formation to do the most damage to this massive Ordovician. 

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/013/081/231/af6456a7163c556e58176b13323994bf_original.gif?w=639&fit=max&v=1468706356&q=92&s=25b9b7b2092435420fc1fa2b133322a2[/img]


[h1]WHAT TO EXPECT FOR EARLY ACCESS: DAY ONE[/h1]

Hive Jump for Early Access focuses on an awesome Arcade experience: action packed run-and-gun gameplay inspired by classics like contra with rouglike touches inspired by industry staples like Spelunky.

[b]You will assume the role of a JUMPER[/b] – a soldier bred for the sole purpose of jumping into alien hives to exterminate the viscous hordes who have overtaken these far away planets. You will customize your JUMPER [b]color (9 total), icon (40 total)[/b] and even select from available [b]jumper skins (4 total[/b]!

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/013/081/282/25ad16d3221d2ac00e5029292b0d12d3_original.gif?w=639&fit=max&v=1468707004&q=92&s=856f4fc8d03b2c9849f143533b742cc1[/img]

[b]The levels or “Hives” of Hive Jump are all procedurally generated –[/b] meaning each new mission will be a fresh challenge for you. Each Hive has 4 different regions which you will face including the [b]Crystal Caverns[/b] and [b]Mushroom Forests[/b] as well as [b]Volcanic[/b] and [b]Ice[/b] themed locations. Each of these regions is fiercely guarded by a major “boss” alien which the player must defeat to progress.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/013/081/285/20dfab190293233f37d1eaa3c1a9da86_original.gif?w=639&fit=max&v=1468707051&q=92&s=16e249406e8c9df3de98b40a9a388aa5[/img]

[b]Earn bonus buffs that improve your "run"![/b] Throughout the mission the player will come across special areas of the hive called “Relic Rooms” which are predesigned challenge rooms that yield player-boosting relics when completed. Players may collect a relic which increases their [b]movement speed[/b], or adds [b]additional armor[/b] to their character among other buffs. These items can be discovered throughout the Hive so the player must explore and discover these treasures to give the best chance for survival!

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/013/081/548/94cf47ea739083974e942e5d24cf322e_original.gif?w=639&fit=max&v=1468708933&q=92&s=dcb575001542abacb80e903592f621a6[/img]

[b]Meet and rescue NPCs to earn valuable resources![/b] As you work through Relic Rooms be on the look-out for NPCs who share lore and also resources such as goo, grenades and health! You never know, some may even be visiting from other amazing indie titles!

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/013/081/576/ad8c96d858872d0d3e296ca06d2757f4_original.gif?w=639&fit=max&v=1468709242&q=92&s=fb2070278e41a7198c5a50416dfcc4b5[/img]

[b]You will be able to unlock and upgrade 11 different weapons![/b] Pulverize aliens with pulse rifles, flamethrowers, gamma rays and more – each with 3 upgrade levels that will supply greater function and power!

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/013/079/736/269d66fbc33735c2875b2d3c0b190faa_original.gif?w=639&fit=max&v=1468693535&q=92&s=72e4ddbef7bee7c960766a2fcd9a6fb5[/img]

[b]Unlock and Equip from a collection of 9 GRENADES to deliver maximum damage to the alien menace.[/b] Grenade types include sticky casing, trip wires, and even cluster bombs which do damage to a wider area.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/013/079/740/75c0087399cca5599bae746f5edce290_original.gif?w=639&fit=max&v=1468693572&q=92&s=529ccbe1e85d13ecea94860066c6b4b2[/img]

[b]Unlock and equip from 8 UTILITY items to support your mission! [/b] These Utility items range from protective shields and teleportation tools to healing items which can all mean the difference between success and a gruesome failure.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/013/079/748/e9369aebf65cdd0d25d1c99190544da4_original.gif?w=639&fit=max&v=1468693644&q=92&s=db70e83b165a6d060dde0d4711327c90[/img]

[b]The Early Access release will feature three different game modes as well.[/b] Players can play an ARCADE mode which drops 1-4 players (local, with online play coming soon - more details listed above in case you missed it) into an alien hive comprised from 3 of the 4 environments. Our fastest runs through this mode have lasted between 30 and 40 minutes making it a perfect “jump in and play” experience!

We’ve also added [b]Daily[/b] and [b]Weekly Challenges[/b] which will load a pre-determined level each day or week, respectively. This will give the “speed run” player something they can practice and improve upon, in order to post scores and times on our leaderboards (which are coming soon, but won’t be available day one).

This is all set to a great soundtrack from [b]Big Giant Circles[/b] (Mass Effect 2, Borderlands 2) with sound design from [b]FatBard[/b] (Crashlands)!

We've worked our tails off to ensure [b]full controller support[/b], so enjoy that twin-stick excellence as you roast enemies with the comfort of a controller! 

[h1]A note about STEAM Online Multiplayer:[/h1]

This one is coming down to the wire. We're confidant we have the right people for the job and that we will have you jumping Hives online with Steam matchmaking soon, but as of today this feature is not complete. Users can access an online lobby, and can search for their friends. They can invite and accept, as well as kick friends from the lobby. Host can start the match and can use chat functions to communicate with their team. Once in a match, however, dis-synchronization of data causes the game to become unplayable. The factors that contribute to this are systems such as the physics system (which we've fixed), but also many others such as random events that can show up in a hive, and also our complex AI (all of which, we are working to fix as quickly as possible).

Any game developer will tell you that networked multiplayer is among the most taxing and time-consuming challenges to add to a game. It’s been our biggest stress with the entire production. We are still devoted to this feature and rest assured we will have it up and running asap, keeping you informed every step of the way.

Each Hive has 4 different regions which you will face including the [b]Crystal Caverns[/b] and [b]Mushroom Forests[/b] as well as [b]Volcanic[/b] and [b]Ice[/b] themed locations. Each of these regions is fiercely guarded by a major “boss” alien which the player must defeat to progress.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/013/081/285/20dfab190293233f37d1eaa3c1a9da86_original.gif?w=639&fit=max&v=1468707051&q=92&s=16e249406e8c9df3de98b40a9a388aa5[/img]

[b]Earn bonus buffs that improve your "run"![/b] Throughout the mission the player will come across special areas of the hive called “Relic Rooms” which are predesigned challenge rooms that yield player-boosting relics when completed. Players may collect a relic which increases their [b]movement speed[/b], or adds [b]additional armor[/b] to their character among other buffs. These items can be discovered throughout the Hive so the player must explore and discover these treasures to give the best chance for survival!

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/013/081/548/94cf47ea739083974e942e5d24cf322e_original.gif?w=639&fit=max&v=1468708933&q=92&s=dcb575001542abacb80e903592f621a6[/img]

[b]Meet and rescue NPCs to earn valuable resources![/b] As you work through Relic Rooms be on the look-out for NPCs who share lore and also resources such as goo, grenades and health! You never know, some may even be visiting from other amazing indie titles!

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/013/081/576/ad8c96d858872d0d3e296ca06d2757f4_original.gif?w=639&fit=max&v=1468709242&q=92&s=fb2070278e41a7198c5a50416dfcc4b5[/img]

[b]You will be able to unlock and upgrade 11 different weapons![/b] Pulverize aliens with pulse rifles, flamethrowers, gamma rays and more – each with 3 upgrade levels that will supply greater function and power!

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/013/079/736/269d66fbc33735c2875b2d3c0b190faa_original.gif?w=639&fit=max&v=1468693535&q=92&s=72e4ddbef7bee7c960766a2fcd9a6fb5[/img]

[b]Unlock and Equip from a collection of 9 GRENADES to deliver maximum damage to the alien menace.[/b] Grenade types include sticky casing, trip wires, and even cluster bombs which do damage to a wider area.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/013/079/740/75c0087399cca5599bae746f5edce290_original.gif?w=639&fit=max&v=1468693572&q=92&s=529ccbe1e85d13ecea94860066c6b4b2[/img]

[b]Unlock and equip from 8 UTILITY items to support your mission! [/b] These Utility items range from protective shields and teleportation tools to healing items which can all mean the difference between success and a gruesome failure.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/013/079/748/e9369aebf65cdd0d25d1c99190544da4_original.gif?w=639&fit=max&v=1468693644&q=92&s=db70e83b165a6d060dde0d4711327c90[/img]

[b]The Early Access release will feature three different game modes as well.[/b] Players can play an ARCADE mode which drops 1-4 players (local, with online play coming soon - more details listed above in case you missed it) into an alien hive comprised from 3 of the 4 environments. Our fastest runs through this mode have lasted between 30 and 40 minutes making it a perfect “jump in and play” experience!

We’ve also added [b]Daily[/b] and [b]Weekly Challenges[/b] which will load a pre-determined level each day or week, respectively. This will give the “speed run” player something they can practice and improve upon, in order to post scores and times on our leaderboards (which are coming soon, but won’t be available day one).

This is all set to a great soundtrack from [b]Big Giant Circles[/b] (Mass Effect 2, Borderlands 2) with sound design from [b]FatBard[/b] (Crashlands)!

We've worked our tails off to ensure [b]full controller support[/b], so enjoy that twin-stick excellence as you roast enemies with the comfort of a controller! 

[h1]A note about STEAM Online Multiplayer:[/h1]

This one is coming down to the wire. We're confidant we have the right people for the job and that we will have you jumping Hives online with Steam matchmaking soon, but as of today this feature is not complete. Users can access an online lobby, and can search for their friends. They can invite and accept, as well as kick friends from the lobby. Host can start the match and can use chat functions to communicate with their team. Once in a match, however, dis-synchronization of data causes the game to become unplayable. The factors that contribute to this are systems such as the physics system (which we've fixed), but also many others such as random events that can show up in a hive, and also our complex AI (all of which, we are working to fix as quickly as possible).

Any game developer will tell you that networked multiplayer is among the most taxing and time-consuming challenges to add to a game. It’s been our biggest stress with the entire production. We are still devoted to this feature and rest assured we will have it up and running asap, keeping you informed every step of the way.

The H.S.A. has begun studying these unique mushrooms and has revealed a slightly regenerative field emanating from them.

notes.title: Gameplay Sneak Peek, NPCs, New Relics, Indy Pop Con!
notes.content:
We're inching ever closer to our [b]STEAM EARLY ACCESS DATE[/b] (JULY 20!!!) Here's another micro-update to get you psyched:

[list]
[*]Gameplay Sneak Peeks
[*]Online Backer Wall
[*]New NPCs
[*]New Relics
[*]Level building
[*]INDY POP CON 
[/list]

[h1]GAMEPLAY SNEAK PEAK![/h1]

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Rermm6FyOvw][img]http://www.hivejump.com/images/hj_steamvid.jpg[/img][/url]

The fellers over at [url=http://itunes.apple.com/us/podcast/gooperative-gamescast-gooperative/id1090786288?mt=2]Gooperative Gaming[/url] posted their second video of their Let's Play session from a few weeks back! This video shows the Harvester as well as the Scorcher which we debuted at [url=https://indypopcon.com/]Indy Pop Con[/url] this past weekend. Check our their video above!

[h1]OUR BACKERS IMMORTALIZED![/h1]

Hive Jump is a kickstarted game. The following is a list of noble and valiant jumpers who voiced their support for the Jump Corps mission to liberate the outer planets from the alien infestations. They are the Hive Jump backers and without them, our mission would not be possible……

Visit: [url=http://hivejump.com/our-backers/]http://hivejump.com/our-backers/[/url]

If you are a backer and don't see your name listed among the heroic jumpers on this page please let us know! Send an email to info@hivejump.com.

Thank You!

[h1]New Rescues located within the Hive...[/h1]

Throughout your exploration of each hive, your jump squad may encounter NPCs who have been long lost as they await rescue.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/012/850/775/5c892df70a44b4af79a14dc7c4fb07aa_original.gif?w=639&fit=max&v=1466785758&q=92&s=08a19eb41fb345ca25976463fcf24ae9[/img]

Each NPC will offer both information and some sort of perk which will aid you in your mission. The best part, is that [b]many of the NPCs found in Hive Jump were designed by our backers![/b]

We've loved getting to collaborate with each of you as we craft the story and lore behind your characters as well as the visual style and animations too! We've posted three of the NPCs you'll find in the game and will share more with each upcoming update!

[h1]New Relics located within the Hive...[/h1]

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/012/851/379/65abc0a30524cf4699dc8b96907f2355_original.jpg?w=639&fit=max&v=1466789984&auto=format&q=92&s=b8f6d82a95f2a4e9ccbf71a89e9e8f77[/img]

[i][b]Rabbit Ears[/b] - This oddly shaped relic appears to be antennae for receiving wireless signals. Before the advent of quantum-entanglement based communications, various wavelengths of the electromagnetic spectrum were manipulated in order to transmit data. Inexplicably, exposure to the bio-electric fields within the hive has caused these antennae to cut through atmospheric disturbance and decrease the time for reinforcements to arrive in the hive.[/i]

[i][b]Valorous Shield[/b] - A makeshift shield reminiscent of those wielded by knights in the days of antiquity. This shield was assembled in great haste by a Tech Officer named Tien from scraps of armor collected from fallen Jumpers after an Ordovician ambush. Tien fought his way out of the hive using nothing but this shield and a handful of scavenged grenades. Tech Officer Tien was awarded a medal for Valorous conduct in delivering data critical to the war effort against all odds. The tools of war may change, but the spirit of valor within human beings remains the same as in the days of the knightly orders of the past.This shield serves as a symbol of valor and protection of human life.[/i]

Relic rooms appear randomly with in the hives so a smart jump team will take time to search them out. We've been revealing new relics with each update and we've got two more for you - these were both designed in collaboration with our backers! 

[h1]More Level Modules, Hazards, and Content! [/h1]

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/012/850/895/0a4f0b9b7eaa1b74d235e0a545a82d25_original.png?w=639&fit=max&v=1466786580&auto=format&lossless=true&s=db6742973e528da59a71ef552480850b[/img]

We continue to crank out new level modules and relic rooms to populate the hives with variety and fun! The system allows our lead designer Matt Donatelli ([url=http://twitter.com/mattdonatelli]@mattdonatelli[/url]) to work quickly and test quickly too! The source is tile based, but we can then see the rendered version too - which looks pretty swanky! 

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/012/850/963/bdc51b17bfecf6ac3c7902a24c7e586f_original.png?w=639&fit=max&v=1466787079&auto=format&lossless=true&s=0231e6924e3336e53a3fa41559577148[/img]

These ice caverns are especially treacherous as there are lots of razor sharp crystals that can harm even the most careful of jumpers! Check out some animations from our resident pixel-wizard Ben Severs (follow [url=http://twitter.com/bsevers18]@bsevers18[/url])!

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/012/851/019/ed3ee22c9da69336a23051ea8a4f586b_original.gif?w=639&fit=max&v=1466787393&q=92&s=3e38812239bf7e2aaadf38a580d1ef1b[/img]

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/012/851/023/7a0e256d23f6337df33c169351ac441e_original.gif?w=639&fit=max&v=1466787408&q=92&s=831b30bf66a03715f060f0180dc2aa3c[/img]

We're very excited to jump into these hives with you on July 20th!

[h1]Hive Jump and Indy Pop Con![/h1]
What can we say about our visit to Indy Pop Con last weekend? It was truly amazing, flattering, and encouraging! Hive Jump EP Matt Raithel ([url=http://twitter.com/raitheoshow]@raitheoshow[/url]) and Lead Designer Matt Donatelli ([url=http://twitter.com/mattdonatelli]@mattdonatelli[/url]) made a road trip to Indianapolis to share the new Lava Environment and Scorcher boss with over 35,000 fans at the con. Little did we know that we would end the weekend with not one, but two rewards for Hive Jump! 

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/012/851/309/c82c607d27b515720eda5f7a6127c0d0_original.jpg?w=639&fit=max&v=1466789550&auto=format&q=92&s=7f84d24a8cbd1f128f4a0c1d4feeedd8[/img]

Oh, yeah, we were also shocked to be brought up on stage and given the grand prize as well! That's designer Matt Donatelli accepting the Skateboard Trophy and a few clams to help get us over the finish line as well!

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/012/851/335/d9f6959f3b650068933b5de00070bd18_original.jpg?w=639&fit=max&v=1466789710&auto=format&q=92&s=5ceff12cfb52186b465f08ee317fffad[/img]

[h1]Would you like to know more?[/h1]

As always, please feel free to add questions or comments below! Your feedback is important to the team!

Don’t forget to follow us on Facebook and Twitter – and tell your friends about the game!

Facebook: [url=https://www.facebook.com/hivejump/] Go to Facebook[/url]

Twitter: [url=https://twitter.com/hivejump]Go to Twitter[/url]

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/012/851/379/65abc0a30524cf4699dc8b96907f2355_original.jpg?w=639&fit=max&v=1466789984&auto=format&q=92&s=b8f6d82a95f2a4e9ccbf71a89e9e8f77[/img]

[i][b]Rabbit Ears[/b] - This oddly shaped relic appears to be antennae for receiving wireless signals. Before the advent of quantum-entanglement based communications, various wavelengths of the electromagnetic spectrum were manipulated in order to transmit data. Inexplicably, exposure to the bio-electric fields within the hive has caused these antennae to cut through atmospheric disturbance and decrease the time for reinforcements to arrive in the hive.[/i]

[i][b]Valorous Shield[/b] - A makeshift shield reminiscent of those wielded by knights in the days of antiquity. This shield was assembled in great haste by a Tech Officer named Tien from scraps of armor collected from fallen Jumpers after an Ordovician ambush. Tien fought his way out of the hive using nothing but this shield and a handful of scavenged grenades. Tech Officer Tien was awarded a medal for Valorous conduct in delivering data critical to the war effort against all odds. The tools of war may change, but the spirit of valor within human beings remains the same as in the days of the knightly orders of the past.This shield serves as a symbol of valor and protection of human life.[/i]

Relic rooms appear randomly with in the hives so a smart jump team will take time to search them out. We've been revealing new relics with each update and we've got two more for you - these were both designed in collaboration with our backers!

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/012/850/895/0a4f0b9b7eaa1b74d235e0a545a82d25_original.png?w=639&fit=max&v=1466786580&auto=format&lossless=true&s=db6742973e528da59a71ef552480850b[/img]

We continue to crank out new level modules and relic rooms to populate the hives with variety and fun! The system allows our lead designer Matt Donatelli ([url=http://twitter.com/mattdonatelli]@mattdonatelli[/url]) to work quickly and test quickly too! The source is tile based, but we can then see the rendered version too - which looks pretty swanky! 

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/012/850/963/bdc51b17bfecf6ac3c7902a24c7e586f_original.png?w=639&fit=max&v=1466787079&auto=format&lossless=true&s=0231e6924e3336e53a3fa41559577148[/img]

These ice caverns are especially treacherous as there are lots of razor sharp crystals that can harm even the most careful of jumpers! Check out some animations from our resident pixel-wizard Ben Severs (follow [url=http://twitter.com/bsevers18]@bsevers18[/url])!

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/012/851/019/ed3ee22c9da69336a23051ea8a4f586b_original.gif?w=639&fit=max&v=1466787393&q=92&s=3e38812239bf7e2aaadf38a580d1ef1b[/img]

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/012/851/023/7a0e256d23f6337df33c169351ac441e_original.gif?w=639&fit=max&v=1466787408&q=92&s=831b30bf66a03715f060f0180dc2aa3c[/img]

We're very excited to jump into these hives with you on July 20th!

[h1]Hive Jump and Indy Pop Con![/h1]
What can we say about our visit to Indy Pop Con last weekend? It was truly amazing, flattering, and encouraging! Hive Jump EP Matt Raithel ([url=http://twitter.com/raitheoshow]@raitheoshow[/url]) and Lead Designer Matt Donatelli ([url=http://twitter.com/mattdonatelli]@mattdonatelli[/url]) made a road trip to Indianapolis to share the new Lava Environment and Scorcher boss with over 35,000 fans at the con. Little did we know that we would end the weekend with not one, but two rewards for Hive Jump! 

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/012/851/309/c82c607d27b515720eda5f7a6127c0d0_original.jpg?w=639&fit=max&v=1466789550&auto=format&q=92&s=7f84d24a8cbd1f128f4a0c1d4feeedd8[/img]

Oh, yeah, we were also shocked to be brought up on stage and given the grand prize as well! That's designer Matt Donatelli accepting the Skateboard Trophy and a few clams to help get us over the finish line as well!

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/012/851/335/d9f6959f3b650068933b5de00070bd18_original.jpg?w=639&fit=max&v=1466789710&auto=format&q=92&s=5ceff12cfb52186b465f08ee317fffad[/img]

notes.content:
[h1]Attention Jumpers![/h1]

We're getting closer to our [b]STEAM EARLY ACCESS DATE (JULY 20!!!)[/b] So the updates are going to come a bit more frequently and be a bit lighter. Here's what you have to look forward to in this update:
[list]
    [*]Gameplay Sneak Peeks
    [*]FAQ Update
    [*]Level building
    [*]New Relics Located
    [*]Indy POP CON
[/list]

[h1]GAMEPLAY SNEAK PEAK![/h1]

The fellers over at [url=https://itunes.apple.com/us/podcast/gooperative-gamescast-gooperative/id1090786288?mt=2] Gooperative Gaming [/url] dropped in to check out the state of the game and do a little raid on the Crusher boss! Check our their [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=y9g2VVLC34I]video![/url]

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=y9g2VVLC34I][img]http://www.graphitelab.com/hivejump/images/goop.jpg[/img][/url]


[h1]New Levels, New Modules, New Hazards, Oh My![/h1]

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/012/746/215/ac065173b3c5eb49bf0b5150a8e96361_original.png?w=639&fit=max&v=1465949462&auto=format&lossless=true&s=d473b85e45d56306d1982d90bbd9c974[/img]

One of the game features we've been very proud of since the beginning is our procedural level generation system and level builder tool. This system allows us to build out all of the different stitch-able pieces that make up a playable hive.

We've been working to build more variety into each of our core environments and that means lots and lots of level design for our lead designer Matt Donatelli ([url=https://twitter.com/mattdonatelli]@mattdonatelli[/url])! 

We're very excited to jump into these hives with you on July 20th!

[h1]New Relics located within the Hive...[/h1]

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/012/733/706/cfd72363e5a395ecd5944791e05273f3_original.jpg?w=639&fit=max&v=1465860932&auto=format&q=92&s=00f2ae89311bc09761c920c4e4fd2334[/img]

[b]Harvester Tail[/b] - The tail of a Harvester is heavily armored but has a nub at the end that is soft, pink, and bulbous. This nub is a sensitive weak spot and has a sphincter that opens up to excrete waste and other substances within the Harvester’s body at extreme velocities. These excretions are often covered with the Harvester’s extremely acidic stomach bile. By studying collected Harvester tails, the H.S.A. is developing protective coatings for Jumper armor that resist the extreme acidity of hazards within Ordovician hives.

[b]Jar of Spores[/b] - This jar full of hive mushroom spores seems to be the result of experiments by an amateur scientist. The seal on the jar is intact, and the spores within are contained effectively. H.S.A. research has shown that prolonged exposure to non-fatal levels of spores seem to have negative effects on human mental health. In heavy concentrations these spores will cause death by asphyxiation. H.S.A. scientists are hard at work developing filters for Jumper suits and every sample helps.

[h1]FAQ Update![/h1]

Thanks to everyone who has been mailing,tweeting and messaging questions! We've tried to get answers back to you asap. Here are a few of the most frequently asked questions posed to us since the last update.

(Don't forget you can check out and post on the new steam community hub too!)

[b]Steam only shows support for PC, what about Mac and Linux?[/b]

Right now we’re only launching Early Access with a PC build, but we will be staggering Mac and Linux releases throughout the Early Access period in order to address any platform-specific concerns. We anticipate that all platforms will be ready for the final launch at the same time, and that there will be cross-platform multiplayer (although this has yet to be tested and verified).

[b]I may not play a lot of multi-player. Would you say Hive Jump is still enjoyable as a single-player experience?[/b]

Most definitely! We've made great strides in developing the single player experience! In addition to normal difficulty scaling features like health / enemy quantity scaling, we’ve also solved other balance issues for one player. For instance, in single-player mode the backpack enters a hover-mode when the player dies, allowing them to re-position the backpack to avoid hazards or enemy fire while waiting to re-spawn. This solved a big issue with player-agency we were having in single-player mode. We're confident single player will be a good experience, and can only get better with the feedback of players who are participating in our Daily "Lone Wolf" Challenges.


Have more questions? Send them our way:  [url=https://www.facebook.com/hivejump/]Facebook[/url] | [url=https://twitter.com/Hivejump]Twitter [/url]

[h1]Hive Jump is headed to Indy Pop Con![/h1]

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/012/746/143/21062e86b5e0e5a78b8f5dd342ff1ef6_original.jpg?w=639&fit=max&v=1465948840&auto=format&q=92&s=638fc8093f5bb0d8dc4d05f336968cf2[/img]

Indy PopCon was founded to celebrate all aspects of pop culture, rather than just hyper focusing on a specific genre. We are stoked to be invited to share Hive Jump at the convention alongside tons of other indie developers, pop culture icons, and other amazing peeps!

Check out the latest demo of Hive Jump on the show floor: Booth #446! Or catch us on the Let's Play stage Friday at 6:00PM!

[h1]Would you like to know more?[/h1]

As always, please feel free to add questions or comments below! Your feedback is important to the team!

Don’t forget to follow us on Facebook and Twitter – and tell your friends about the game!

[url=https://www.facebook.com/hivejump/]Facebook[/url] | [url=https://twitter.com/Hivejump]Twitter [/url]
